meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试 Senpi 适配器隔离运行，确保不污染真实环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改动过 Senpi 适配器代码，想要隔离验证却不想碰真实数据。
copy.tagline_en: Test the Senpi adapter in isolation without touching your real environment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the Senpi adapter and need isolated QA without touching real data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用真实的 senpi 二进制在隔离沙箱里对 omo Senpi 适配器和任务引擎跑 QA，把捕获的 JSON 证据和 README 写进唯一路径 .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/。
howto.when: 当你改动 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下的内容，或提到“senpi qa”等关键词做 QA、冒烟测试、调试时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑 senpi qa，QA 一下 omo Senpi 适配器
say.note: 先解析证据目录，再运行 live 驱动脚本

say.text: 验证 senpi task e2e：任务启动、流式输出和终态
say.note: 运行 task-e2e.mjs，驱动真实二进制

say.text: 检查 senpi team e2e 的注入投递和 exactly-once 恢复
say.note: 运行 team-e2e.mjs 并写证据

howto.what_en: Claude runs QA on the omo Senpi adapter and task engine against the real senpi binary in isolation, and writes captured JSON evidence plus a README to the single canonical path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task changes, or when you mention "senpi qa" etc., or want to QA, smoke-test, verify or debug the Senpi adapter.

say_en.text: Run senpi qa on the omo Senpi adapter
say_en.note: Resolves the evidence dir, then runs the live driver

say_en.text: Verify senpi task e2e: task start, streaming, and terminal states
say_en.note: Runs task-e2e.mjs against the real binary

say_en.text: Check senpi team e2e injection delivery and exactly-once recovery
say_en.note: Runs team-e2e.mjs and writes the evidence README
